title: A Geometrically Convergent Solution to Spatial Hypercube Queueing Models
summary: The hypercube queueing model was initially developed to address spatial queueing problems and has found wide applications in emergency services, such as ambulance and police systems. While the model was originally designed for homogeneous service rates, we extend it to handle heterogeneous service rates by devising an exact solution through a birth-death process and an equivalent reformulation.
